```yaml
name: Check PR Assignee and Run Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]

jobs:
  check-assignee:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify PR is assigned to devin
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const assignees = context.payload.pull_request.assignees.map(a => a.login);
            if (!assignees.includes('devin')) {
              core.setFailed(`PR must be assigned to devin. Current assignees: ${assignees.join(', ')}`);
            }

  test:
    needs: check-assignee
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run type-check
        run: npm run type-check

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build
```
